title: Witch on the Holy Night
description:
In the manor upon the hill lived two witches. The late 1980s marks the twilight of an era of glamor and vigor. A boy arrives in the city and encounters two witches living in the modern age. Soujyuro Sizuki makes a normal life for himself, while Aoko Aozaki ventures forth with pride, and Alice Kuonji lies in slumberous seclusion. The paths of these three could have remained separate, had it not been for an azure miracle that sparked a particular winter's night. The echoes of the mystical and the youthful resonate in this tale of beginnings. 

(Source: K MANGA)
author: Keigo Maki, Type-Moon
